column3: Concerning the 3466 Shippers Drive Mortgaged Property (0.2%), having an allocated loan amount of $27,551,148 or 1.7% of the related Whole Loan amount, an REC associated with prior orchard uses was identified, including arsenic and possibly metals in shallow soils. Some soil removal was conducted incidental to current development of the site, including extensive paved areas, but formal abatement testing and documentation was not obtained. The environmental consultant provided an upper range estimate within a statistical 90% confidence interval that costs to address additional investigation and remediation would not exceed $235,000.
